build.buildCommand: pip install -e '.[api]' && cd web && npm install && rm -rf build && npm run build && mkdir -p ../src/sema/server/static && cp -r build/client/* ../src/sema/server/static/

deploy.startCommand: cd /app/web && rm -rf build && npm run build && mkdir -p ../src/sema/server/static && cp -r build/client/* ../src/sema/server/static/ && cd /app && sema serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
